ops:
My screen shows multiple bogeys closing
on our position.
Looks like we're in for a fight.

That depends on how reasonable you're
willing to be, my love.

Either head due east and land at
our airstrip...
...or we'll blow you out of the sky.
What the hell's going on here?
I told you a small lie earlier, darling.

I did leave the Jackals, but not to be
with you.

I left because I want to collect that
bounty against Mendez...

...and that F22 is going to make
it possible.
That's hardly a small lie, Janet.

Well, believe this, at least. I never
meant to hurt you...

Please, just land the plane and make
this easy for everyone.
Loving you was never easy, Janet...
